title: Great way to experience local food.
text: We had a great time. It was like a private tour as it was our party of three. Our guide Yvonne was very friendly. The places we were taken to all had delicious food.
author: 973winstons

title: A good time in Barcelona
text:
Yvonne was a fantastic guide and very good company. We tried a lot of great places and she was also accomodating for dietary constraints. 

10/10
